items.name: Silver Knight Helm
items.description: Open face, shiny plume. Armour for the exam hall.

items.name: Gold Knight Helm
items.description: Golden and glorious, slightly heavy for a long lecture.

items.name: Bronze Knight Helm
items.description: Warm bronze with a green plume. Ready for finals.

items.name: Elf Ears
items.description: Pointy ears for listening to the lecture from far away.

items.name: Moonlit Elf Ears
items.description: Pale ears for late-night study sessions under the moon.

items.name: Forest Elf Ears
items.description: Green ears for studying under the trees.

items.name: Unicorn Horn Band
items.description: A little horn on a pink band. Sparkly enough for the library.

items.name: Sky Unicorn Horn
items.description: Sky-blue and lilac, mostly for show, a bit for focus.

items.name: Jade Dragon Hood
items.description: Dragon-sized deadlines need a dragon-sized hood.

items.name: Ember Dragon Hood
items.description: Warm enough to keep a small fire going, probably.

items.name: Star Circlet
items.description: A gold circlet with a star that twinkles at good ideas.

items.name: Ice Rune Marks
items.description: Old letters on your cheeks. Nobody needs to know what they mean.

items.name: Gold Rune Marks
items.description: Ancient marks that say: read one more chapter.

items.name: Rose Rune Marks
items.description: Rose-pink runes. They probably mean something good.

items.name: Ruby Forehead Gem
items.description: A red gem for the brain that never stops thinking.

items.name: Sapphire Forehead Gem
items.description: A calm blue gem for steady focus.

items.name: Masquerade Mask
items.description: A mysterious mask with sparkly tips. Only slightly distracting.

items.name: Silver Breastplate
items.description: Shiny armour for facing the reading list.

items.name: Bronze Breastplate
items.description: Old-fashioned armour with a cream trim.

items.name: Crimson Breastplate
items.description: Bold red armour for the final push.

items.name: Midnight Robe
items.description: Dark blue with gold stars, for late-night reading.

items.name: Plum Star Robe
items.description: Soft plum with pink stars for very serious thinking.

items.name: Forest Star Robe
items.description: Library green with gold stars all over it.

items.name: Frost Fairy Wings
items.description: Pale blue wings. Very light, very helpful for flashcards.

items.name: Mint Fairy Wings
items.description: Mint wings with gold veins, the lightest load you carry.

items.name: Ebony Magic Wand
items.description: Dark wood and a gold star. Wave it at the textbook.

items.name: Ivory Magic Wand
items.description: Ivory with a pink star. Wave it gently at the textbook.

items.name: Jade Magic Wand
items.description: Green and silver. Works best with a cup of tea.

items.name: Potion Trio
items.description: Three bottles of focus. Label them carefully.

items.name: Green Potion Trio
items.description: Three green bottles. Do not drink, just study.

items.name: Red Round Shield
items.description: A round shield with a gold boss for stormy exam weeks.

items.name: Blue Round Shield
items.description: Blue and cream, for defending your evenings.

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.description: Shows you the answer, or at least the next chapter.

items.name: Dragon Egg
items.description: Warm to the touch. Hatches after enough study hours.

items.name: Quest Banner
items.description: A banner for your quests. It waves when you finish one.

items.name: Tiny Dragon
items.description: A small dragon that keeps watch over your notes.

items.name: Fairy Dust
items.description: Pink and aqua sparkles drifting around you.

items.name: Magic Circle
items.description: A glowing rune circle. Stand inside and focus.

items.name: Phoenix
items.description: A phoenix circles you in warm light. It never burns out.
